summary: MAIA Biotechnology filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 reporting the termination of its at-the-market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. The filing is a routine update to withdraw the prospectus supplement after suspending sales; it does not involve a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or any special-situation transaction. No deal terms are present; the filing merely ends a standing equity distribution arrangement.
